issues.basis: NL3; PlantUML separators establish orthogonal regions; canonical and closed projections preserve the concurrent CollisionAvoidance region structure; source trace provides exact region identity mappings.
issues.expected: CollisionAvoidance has orthogonal regions supporting concurrent activation of distinct controls.
issues.observed: CollisionAvoidance is represented as a concurrent composite with four region projections, including separate braking, steering, and alert-control regions.
issues.reason: The exact source and closed-model owner both expose orthogonal concurrent regions, so this structural contract is satisfied. The separate numeric mismatch is reported against NL1 and is not duplicated here.
issues.requirement_quote: The orthogonal regions of the active mode of collision avoidance allow for concurrent activation different of collision avoidance controls.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The supplied source and closed structure explicitly provide orthogonal regions and distinct control areas, supporting the required concurrency relation.
issues.title: Collision-avoidance orthogonal region structure is present

issues.basis: NL2; exact source transitions tr_0003-tr_0005; FCSTM transitions line 23-25; inspection event-consumer rows for the three events; reachability facts marking CollisionDetection and PossibleCollision unreachable.
issues.expected: The CollisionAvoidance sub-machine becomes active in response to each of the three collision-detection events.
issues.observed: The exact consumers for Frontend_Detected, Rear_end_Detected, and Pedestrian_Detected are declared on PossibleCollision, but all three consumer transitions have empty reachable-consumer sets because CollisionDetection and its descendants are unreachable from the top-level initial entry.
issues.reason: The trigger-set obligation is operational rather than merely declarative. Exact deterministic facts show all three declared collision event consumers are unreachable from the root, so none can activate the required sub-machine in the closed model.
issues.requirement_quote: This sub-machine becomes active when a possible frontend collision, rear-end collision or collision with pedestrian is detected.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The three event consumers and their corresponding source transitions are present, but declaration alone does not establish reachable operational coverage; no supplied fact shows a reachable consumer.
issues.title: Collision-avoidance activation consumers are unreachable

issues.basis: NL3; canonical source IR concurrent-region count four; source trace region projections; FCSTM state CollisionAvoidance; inspection and verify facts marking CollisionAvoidance unreachable.
issues.expected: CollisionAvoidance provides orthogonal regions whose controls can be concurrently active when the mode is active.
issues.observed: The source/model projection contains four concurrent regions, but the CollisionAvoidance composite is unreachable from the top-level initial entry. Therefore the region structure cannot become active in the closed model's reachable behavior.
issues.reason: The exact structural region projection is present, but the behavioral consequence requested by this lens is not closed: the owning composite is unreachable from the root. This is a precise region-structure consequence and is not reducible to declaration membership or a single endpoint predicate.
issues.requirement_quote: The orthogonal regions of the active mode of collision avoidance allow for concurrent activation different of collision avoidance controls.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The closed model contains the four projected regions and their child states, so the structural declaration exists; the remaining issue is that root reachability prevents their operational activation.
issues.title: Collision-avoidance region structure is not operationally reachable
